sentences.en: Evidences show that the so-called " meta- albilite" is actually meta-dacite-liparite.

sentences.en: This article has analyzed and expounded the system synthesis theory and discussed the significance of the meta- synthesis theory, which used in transportation system study.

sentences.en: After pretreatment and dilution, waste sulfuric acid from titanium white production was used for preparation of resorcinol by acidic hydrolysis of meta- phenylenediamine .
